description: This file defines a servlet named AddEnquiry that handles HTTP POST requests to process user enquiries by extracting parameters and inserting them into a database.

classes.name: AddEnquiry
classes.description: A servlet class for handling user enquiry submissions via POST requests, inserting data into the database and redirecting or forwarding based on success.

methods.name: doPost
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests, extracts enquiry details from request parameters, inserts enquiry data into the database, and redirects or forwards based on the insertion result.
